title: genoa unified manifest
description: v1 manifest schema for smolBSD-for-agents image build. Feed this to `genoa build`.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must be 'v1'. Bump to v2 on breaking changes.

name.description: Slug used as the output filename stem. Example: 'smolbsd-rpi5-iiagent'.

version.description: SemVer tag for this image build. Example: 'v0.1.0'.

format.description: Output image format. 'qcow2' preferred for QEMU (sparse, snapshot-capable).

size_mb.description: Provisioned image size in MiB. Actual artifact will be smaller if format=qcow2 (sparse).

output_dir.description: Directory where the finished image and receipt are written. Defaults to './out'.

description.description: Human-readable description of this image's purpose.

target.description: Target platform: OS, architecture, and hypervisor profile.

platform.description: Target hardware/hypervisor platform. Drives kernel config selection and loader defaults.

build_host.description: Optional: SSH destination for the build host (e.g. 'builder@fb-vm-24:2225'). Omit to build locally.

kernel.description: Kernel configuration delta applied on top of the base config.

config.description: Kernel config name. Use a built-in (GENERIC, MINIMAL, RPI) or a custom config name from kernel_delta_file.

kernel_delta_file.description: Optional path to a kernel config delta file to deploy alongside config. Relative to manifest location.

extra_options.description: Additional nodevice/nooptions/options lines injected into the kernel config.

strip_debug.description: Strip debug symbols from kernel binary. Reduces size by ~50%.

packages.description: Package set for the image. Follows FreeBSD pkgbase conventions.

include.description: Packages to include. Use pkgbase names for FreeBSD base packages.

exclude_patterns.description: Glob patterns to exclude. Applied via vm_extra_filter_base_packages().

pkg_repo.description: pkg repository URL. Defaults to FreeBSD quarterly.

agent.description: Agent payload baked into the image.

version.description: SemVer version of the agent binary.

source.description: Where to fetch the agent binary from.

url.description: Direct download URL (used when type='url' or 'gitea_release').

asset.description: Asset filename within the Gitea release.

sha256.description: Expected SHA-256 hex digest of the fetched binary. Required for url and gitea_release.

install_path.description: Absolute path inside the image where the agent binary is installed.

rc_service.description: Optional rc.d service configuration to start the agent at boot.

command_args.description: Arguments passed to the agent binary when started by rc.d.

config.description: Agent-specific configuration key/value pairs baked into the image.

static_ip.description: IP/prefix in CIDR notation (used when mode=static).

profile.description: Boot profile for the image. Drives which build profile is invoked.

deploy.description: Deployment configuration for dispatch to cloud providers.

provider.description: Provider ID from the catalog (e.g., 'vultr', 'linode'). Used to look up deployment_path.

path_override.description: Optional override of the deployment_path from catalog. Use only if catalog entry is incomplete or needs adjustment.

oci_availability_domain.description: OCI availability domain for instance launch. Required for OCI provider. Example: 'Uocm:US-ASHBURN-AD-1'.

oci_namespace.description: OCI Object Storage namespace. Required for OCI provider.

oci_bucket.description: OCI Object Storage bucket name. Defaults to 'genoa-images'.

oci_compartment_id.description: OCI compartment OCID. Required for OCI image import and instance launch.

oci_subnet_id.description: OCI subnet OCID for instance launch. Required for OCI provider.

oci_shape.description: OCI compute shape. Defaults to 'VM.Standard.A1.Flex' (free tier ARM).

signing.description: Image signing configuration. If omitted, image is unsigned.

tool.description: Signing tool. 'signify' uses OpenBSD signify(1) / FreeBSD signify-ossl.

key_file.description: Path to the signify private key file (.sec). Keep outside of version control.

public_key_file.description: Path to the signify public key file (.pub). Embedded in receipt.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata carried into the receipt.
